program.title: AIMayaTool Complete Migration & Modernization
program.completion_gate: Do not declare the program complete until the final legacy parity audit proves every useful Skinning, Setup and Scene workflow is Migrated, Replaced/Improved, or Intentionally Retired with explicit rationale, and full Maya regression plus production release acceptance pass.
program.execution_policy: Proceed autonomously goal-by-goal and milestone-by-milestone within this owner-approved program. Keep only the earliest incomplete goal active; later goals remain planned until predecessors close. Replenish safe dependency-ready tasks continuously according to GUIDE.md.

goals.title: Reusable AIBrigde-backed Maya project foundation
goals.purpose: Establish AIMayaTool as a project profile that inherits AIBrigde system contracts while adding Maya-specific architecture, validation, routers, and migration rules locally so future projects can follow the same pattern with minimal AIBrigde changes.
acceptance: AIMayaTool declares AIBrigde as its platform/runtime and does not copy or fork worker lifecycle code.
AIMayaTool keeps its own GUIDE.md, goal source, task source, capability manifest, and router manifest.
Rule precedence is AIBrigde system contracts, then AIMayaTool project Guide, then task-specific instructions.
Generic queue, ACK, Git, provider, permission, retry, and restart behavior remains owned by AIBrigde.
Maya-specific validation can progress through Python verification, mayapy/headless validation, Maya batch, and interactive Maya live validation as appropriate.
The project-profile pattern is documented so future projects can reuse it without duplicating AIBrigde runtime code.

goals.title: Full legacy inventory and parity map
goals.purpose: Inventory MayaScriptNew Skinning, Setup, and Scene end-to-end; map every useful workflow/helper/UI action to AIMayaTool status and dependencies so no legacy capability is silently lost.
acceptance: All Skinning, Setup, and Scene legacy workflows are represented in a durable parity map.
Each item is classified as migrated, missing, replaced/improved, duplicate/internal-only, or intentionally retired with rationale.
Remaining work has dependency-aware migration priority.

milestones.title: Order remaining slices by dependency and value

goals.title: Skinning complete migration
goals.purpose: Migrate every useful Skinning workflow from MayaScriptNew into maintainable AIMayaTool architecture with explicit deterministic primitives and thin interactive adapters.
acceptance: Every useful MayaScriptNew Skinning workflow is available or intentionally superseded.
No legacy NLTA module becomes the new public API.
All host-mutating workflows have appropriate Maya validation.

milestones.title: Complete graph, gradient, proxy and advanced helpers
Expose complete Skinning workflows in UI
Validate complete Skinning parity in Maya

goals.title: Skinning 2.0 modernization
goals.purpose: Upgrade Skinning beyond parity for performance, safety, batch productivity, discoverability, and production UX.
acceptance: Skinning is measurably easier and safer to use than MayaScriptNew.
Performance-sensitive operations use efficient APIs where justified.
UI exposes status/progress and prevents common invalid operations.

milestones.title: Profile and optimize geometry/weight hot paths
Add safe batch/preview/progress patterns where useful
Improve undo, validation and actionable errors

goals.title: Setup complete migration
goals.purpose: Migrate every useful Setup/rigging workflow from MayaScriptNew including controls, transforms, constraints, IK/FK, spaces, SDK/driven keys, secondary rigs, proxy attributes and reusable rig utilities.
acceptance: Every useful MayaScriptNew Setup workflow is available or intentionally superseded.
Character-specific assumptions are configuration rather than hidden behavior.
Setup workflows are composable and Maya-validated.

milestones.title: Expose complete Setup workflows in UI
Validate complete Setup parity in Maya

goals.title: Setup 2.0 modernization
goals.purpose: Upgrade Setup workflows with safer composition, mirroring/batching, validation, presets and production-focused UX.
acceptance: Setup provides clear improvements over MayaScriptNew in speed, safety and reuse.
Destructive operations are guarded and errors are actionable.

milestones.title: Add reusable presets and preflight validation

goals.title: Scene complete migration
goals.purpose: Migrate every useful Scene and ScenePattern workflow from MayaScriptNew, including serialization, pattern management, display layers, setup/build actions and required legacy data compatibility.
acceptance: Every useful MayaScriptNew Scene workflow is available or intentionally superseded.
Scene data operations are deterministic and versionable.
Required legacy project data can be migrated safely.

milestones.title: Expose complete Scene workflows in UI
Validate complete Scene parity in Maya

goals.title: Scene 2.0 modernization
goals.purpose: Upgrade Scene workflows with stronger preset management, compare/edit/validation, reusable build pipelines and clearer workflow visualization.
acceptance: Scene workflows provide clear productivity and reliability improvements over MayaScriptNew.

goals.title: Unified UI and UX 2.0
goals.purpose: Deliver one coherent professional AIMayaTool workspace for Skinning, Setup and Scene with consistent visual language and interaction patterns.
acceptance: Skinning, Setup and Scene feel like one product rather than migrated scripts.
Common actions are discoverable with compact consistent controls.
UI remains thin over domain APIs.

milestones.title: Add search/discovery and useful recent/favorite access

goals.title: Workflow intelligence and productivity
goals.purpose: Add safe productivity features such as contextual selection, presets, smart defaults, favorites/recent actions, batch operations and preflight validation.
acceptance: Productivity features reduce repetitive manual work without hiding destructive behavior or weakening explicit APIs.

goals.title: Performance and Maya API modernization
goals.purpose: Profile AIMayaTool and modernize proven hot paths using Maya API 2.0, caching and bounded batching where it materially improves production performance.
acceptance: Optimization is evidence-driven and behavior-preserving.
No optimization sacrifices correctness or maintainability without documented reason.

goals.title: Reliability, undo and recovery
goals.purpose: Harden all three domains for production use with undo safety, scene-state protection, robust validation, deterministic failures and bounded Maya runtime recovery.
acceptance: Common invalid inputs fail safely and clearly.
Mutating workflows preserve expected undo/scene behavior.
Runtime-loss evidence is handled according to Guide recovery contracts.

milestones.title: Protect scene state during mutating workflows

goals.title: Full legacy parity audit
goals.purpose: Re-scan MayaScriptNew from scratch against the finished AIMayaTool and prove no useful Skinning, Setup or Scene workflow was omitted.
acceptance: Every useful legacy item is Migrated, Replaced/Improved, or Intentionally Retired with explicit rationale.
No unexplained Skinning, Setup or Scene parity gap remains.

goals.title: Full Maya regression and production validation
goals.purpose: Validate the complete product through deterministic Python, mayapy/headless, Maya batch and interactive Maya tiers using representative production workflows.
acceptance: Passing evidence exists at the cheapest sufficient tier for every capability and interactive workflows are proven in Maya.
No known blocking regression remains.

goals.title: AIMayaTool production release
goals.purpose: Finish cleanup, documentation, bootstrap/install/update experience, versioning and release polish so AIMayaTool can replace MayaScriptNew in production.
acceptance: AIMayaTool is the production replacement for MayaScriptNew across Skinning, Setup and Scene.
All preceding goals are completed.
Release state is reproducible, documented and backed by proven Maya validation.
